summary_points.text: The design was over budget, so the team looked for features to cut
The LCD display and the advanced chip were removed and replaced by a regular chip, with feedback shown on the television
The buttons will be normal coloured, which brought the remote under budget with about 0.5 Euro to spare
The logo will be embossed, and the remote's dimensions were discussed: about 2.5 centimetres high

decisions.text: The LCD display is removed; the television shows what the user is doing
The advanced chip is replaced by a regular chip
The buttons will be normal coloured
The logo will be embossed (counted as a special form for the buttons)
The remote will be about 2.5 centimetres high
The remote will be about three centimetres wide
